# BioFarmLab Wiedza

BioFarmLab Wiedza is the public knowledge base of BioFarmLab about soil biology, compost, regenerative agriculture, biological analysis and composting technology.

Canonical site: https://wiedza.biofarmlab.pl/

Language hubs:
- Polish: https://wiedza.biofarmlab.pl/pl/
- English: https://wiedza.biofarmlab.pl/en/
- German: https://wiedza.biofarmlab.pl/de/
- French: https://wiedza.biofarmlab.pl/fr/
- Italian: https://wiedza.biofarmlab.pl/it/
- Spanish: https://wiedza.biofarmlab.pl/es/

Main organization: https://biofarmlab.pl/
